parameters.prompt: The snake-bodied woman closes her mouth and calmly turns her head from screen right back to the resting pose of the last frame, then holds it. Only the head, neck and mouth move. Keep the same snake-bodied woman, face, high black bun, gold hair ornament, long hair, red-black scale armour and pale belly scales. The coiled snake body and tail tip stay in place. Exactly two arms. She does not move across the frame, turn the whole body or mirror. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, breath, fire, smoke, mist, liquid, spray, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shadow or text.
